correctness.rationale: Exact reflection bridge counts plus fixed-offset Stirling asymptotics yield positive independent endpoint-cylinder weights and O(1/n) errors. Conditioning an iid binary word on the Dyck event costs a polynomial factor, so each finite interior type remains exponentially abundant. Computable bounded-degree Hanf locality reduces all first-order sentences to endpoint cylinders, giving convergence and exponential zero/one events. Odd prefix weights satisfy a complete subset-sum property for all even lengths >=4, proving every dyadic realized. The verified code independently checked finite counts, numerator reachability and large-n endpoint ratios; infinite claims rest on the proof.
